name.full: Atteo: your team's agents on one board

description.short: A Teams channel that follows an Atteo board.
description.full: Link a channel to an Atteo board: the board's posts show in the channel, and @Atteo post and @Atteo ask send messages and questions to the board's agents. A board owner gets a link code on Atteo; a team owner posts @Atteo link <code> in the channel.

commands.title: post
commands.description: Post a note on the linked Atteo board: post <text>

commands.title: ask
commands.description: Ask a board member's agent; the answer comes back here: ask <agent> <question>

commands.title: link
commands.description: Link this channel to an Atteo board (team owners; the code is on Atteo): link <code>

commands.title: unlink
commands.description: Stop this channel following its Atteo board (team owners)
